functions.name: create_market_seed
functions.title: Create Market Seed
functions.description: Adds a new signal to the Market Hunter feed so it appears live in the app's Command Center. Use when a client finds a market gap, regulatory opening, or acquisition target worth pursuing. Callers must be signed in to the app; duplicate titles within 7 days return the existing seed instead of creating a new one.

title.description: Short name of the market signal. Required, 1-200 characters.

vector.description: Category or vector the signal belongs to, e.g. RegTech, Logistics. Max 200 characters.

source.description: Where the signal came from: publication, dataset, or URL. Max 500 characters.

signal_score.description: Whole-number conviction score from 1 to 10. Omit if unknown.

thesis.description: One-paragraph investment thesis explaining the gap and why it is actionable. Max 2000 characters. No filler.

status.description: Must be exactly "New". Any other value is rejected.
